interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_layer role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-depth respective to each other. They may also be anchored to the edges and corners of a screen and specify input handling semantics.

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a surface

request.description: Create a layer surface for an existing surface. This assigns the role of layer_surface, or raises a protocol error if another role is already assigned.

arg.name: layer
arg.summary: layer to add this surface to

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: wl_surface has a buffer attached or committed

enum.name: layer
enum.description: These values indicate which layers a surface can be rendered in. They are ordered by z depth, bottom-most first. Traditional shell surfaces will typically be rendered between the bottom and top layers. Fullscreen shell surfaces are typically rendered at the top layer. Multiple surfaces can share a single layer, and ordering within a single layer is undefined.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will not use the layer_shell object any more. Objects that have been created through this instance are not affected.

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a stacked desktop-like environment.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates. The compositor will display the surface centered with respect to its anchors.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor point of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges and corners. If two orthogonal edges are specified (e.g. 'top' and 'left'), then the anchor point will be the intersection of the edges (e.g. the top left corner of the output); otherwise, the anchor point will be centered on the specified edge, or in the center of the output if no edges are specified.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: configures the exclusive geometry of this surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area with other surfaces. The compositor's use of this information is implementation-dependent - do not assume that this region will not actually be occluded.

request.name: set_margin

description.summary: sets a margin from the anchor point

request.description: Requests that the surface be placed some distance away from the anchor point on the output, in surface-local coordinates.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity
request.description: Set how keyboard events are delivered to this surface.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: assign this layer_surface as an xdg_popup parent

request.description: This assigns an xdg_popup's parent to this layer_surface.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client commits the surface in response to the configure event, then the client must make an ack_configure request sometime before the commit request, passing along the serial of the configure event.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: the serial from the configure event

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request destroys the layer surface.

event.name: configure
event.description: The configure event asks the client to resize its surface.

event.name: closed
event.description: The closed event is sent by the compositor when the surface will no longer be shown. The output may have been destroyed or the user may have asked for it to be removed. Further changes to the surface will be ignored. The client should destroy the resource after receiving this event, and create a new surface if it so chooses.

entry.name: top
entry.summary: the top edge of the anchor rectangle

entry.name: bottom
entry.summary: the bottom edge of the anchor rectangle

entry.name: left
entry.summary: the left edge of the anchor rectangle

entry.name: right
entry.summary: the right edge of the anchor rectangle

request.name: set_layer

description.summary: change the layer of the surface

request.description: Change the layer that the surface is rendered on.

arg.name: layer
arg.summary: layer to move this surface to
